title: billing.capture
description: Payload for the billing.capture comm Function — bill a hold for what the work actually cost and write the ledger row (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.capture). actual_credits defaults to the full reserved amount; less refunds the difference into the lots it came from with their original expiry, more takes the extra from the live lots and can fail with insufficient_credits. No idempotency_key: hold_id IS the key — capturing an already-captured hold returns the charge written the first time. Returns {"ok": bool, "balance": int|null, "transaction_id": str|null, "reason": str|null}; reason is one of hold_not_found, hold_not_held, insufficient_credits.
